needs_review.question_text_raw: The paper title announces 'two open problems', but the source is a short 4-page PDF whose font encoding makes most of pages 1-3 unreadable in local extraction. The reliably readable page 4 evidence shows the paper proving that a conjecture is false for c = 1/2 and giving an example where neither S nor T has a fixed point, which suggests the paper answers previously open problems rather than clearly posing a still-open one. I could not recover verbatim, page-cited statements of the two problem formulations from the chosen primary source with enough confidence to rewrite them self-containedly.
